personality_one_liner: An elegant, deeply welcoming editorial space that feels like flipping through a high-end wellness magazine.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Use magazine-like spacing rhythms.

do's: Use only if absolutely necessary for floating sticky actions over busy content, but prefer solid surface/surfaceSecondary for an editorial feel.
dont's: Do not use glass heavily, as it clashes with the Editorial/Print personality.

screens.name: Auth (Cadastro/Login)
screens.purpose: A gentle, trusting entry into the salon experience with clear LGPD compliance.

states.error: Inline red text below inputs, toast for network errors.

screens.layout: Full-width editorial layout. Large serif title 'Bem-vinda'. Inputs are flat with a simple `border` (no shadows). Sticky CTA 'Entrar' or 'Cadastrar' at the bottom of the screen.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Inspiration and quick access to scheduling and featured services.

states.error: Toast message, retry button below greeting.

screens.layout: Personalized serif greeting at top. Hero promo banner: image with a gradient scrim and white serif overlay. Below: 'Serviços' as an elegant horizontal scroll of image cards (Hair, Nails, Depilation). Bottom: a quick 'Agendar Novamente' card if they have history.

screens.name: Catálogo & Agendamento
screens.purpose: Browse the service menu beautifully and book effortlessly.

states.loading: Spinner in the center of the list.

screens.layout: Top segmented control (Cabelo / Unhas / Depilação). List of services using generous padding, serif titles, and clear price/duration metadata. Tapping 'Agendar' opens a Bottom Sheet (gorhom/bottom-sheet) to select a professional (optional), then Date/Time using a clean horizontal calendar and time pills. Sticky 'Confirmar Agendamento' CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Meus Agendamentos
screens.purpose: Clear visibility into upcoming appointments and past history.

states.empty: Elegant line-art icon with 'Você não possui agendamentos'. Primary CTA 'Explorar Serviços'.

screens.layout: Top tab switch: 'Futuros' and 'Histórico'. Cards are structural, using thin `border` without shadow. Emphasize date and time in a distinct serif block. Secondary actions ('Reagendar', 'Cancelar') inside the card for upcoming items.

screens.name: Perfil
screens.purpose: Manage personal details and view procedural history.
screens.layout: Center avatar with a prominent serif name. List of editable fields using clean list rows. A dedicated section 'Histórico de Procedimentos' showing a chronological list of past services.

instructions_to_main_agent: Adhere to the '3 Editorial Mobile' personality: rely on generous whitespace, elegant serif typography (Playfair Display) for headers, and clean sans-serif (Satoshi) for body text.
Use the soft rose/blush (#DDA7A5) and gold (#D4B483) sparingly as accents against the warm off-white (#FAFAF7) background to maintain a sophisticated, non-overwhelming feminine feel.
Borders should be used instead of shadows to delineate cards and lists (shadow tier is 0).
When placing text over the hero banner or category images, ALWAYS use a gradient scrim (top to bottom, transparent to ≥70% surfaceInverse) to ensure text readability.
For the booking flow, use a bottom sheet (`@gorhom/bottom-sheet`) to keep the user in context while selecting a professional and date/time.
Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, service cards) have at least 44x44pt touch targets.
Always maintain a sticky primary CTA at the bottom of scrollable screens (e.g., 'Confirmar Agendamento' in the booking flow).
